newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy offers firm, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy offers firm, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers firmed one cent a bushel on Friday in most positions while corn and wheat values were steady, export sources said.
Dealers noted quiet export activity and a lack of farm sales in export channels.

On the export front, Jordan will seek a total of about 120,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red wheat and/or northern spring/dark northern spring wheat on May 1, under the PL-480, Title I export program.
